# Twahanur Rahman

> Full-Stack Developer specializing in multi-tenant SaaS architecture, RAG systems, and scalable backends with NestJS, Next.js, PostgreSQL, Docker & Redis.

## About
Twahanur Rahman is a software engineer based in Dhaka, Bangladesh, building modern web applications, high-performance APIs, microservices, and AI-powered systems.

## Primary Tech Stack
- Frontend: Next.js, React 19, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Framer Motion
- Backend: Node.js, NestJS, Express.js, TypeScript
- Databases: PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Redis
- DevOps & Cloud: Docker, Cloudflare Workers, Vercel, Linux
- AI & LLM: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), Gemini API, OpenAI API, LangChain
